exceptions.deployment_boundary: Embedded PersistentClient only; no Chroma server or Chroma HTTP API is deployed.
compensating_controls: No Chroma port, container, HttpClient, or tenant API is exposed.
The application API remains behind its own authentication and RBAC boundary.
exceptions.remediation: Upgrade to the first audited stable Chroma release that fixes both advisories, or replace the embedded vector store before expiry.
